summary:
Twitter bank-research catalog for Sep 5-7, 2026: JPMorgan Asset Management dominates volume with 22 charts (relayed by @MikeZaccardi) spanning valuation multiples, index concentration, retirement-asset growth, and the AI-driven shift in S&P 500 earnings composition. Deutsche Bank contributes 3 items on AI competitive dynamics, hyperscaler debt issuance, and a September geopolitical calendar. Apollo's Torsten Slok flags vanishing multiple expansion alongside a hot jobs/ISM prices-paid print. BofA, Goldman, and Morgan Stanley each contribute one chart, covering secular/cyclical market cycles, the Communacopia tech conference, and hyperscaler off-balance-sheet AI commitments respectively. Hyperscaler AI capex/debt and stretched market concentration are the throughlines across desks this week.

Per-bank counts: JPM 22, Deutsche 3, Apollo/Slok 2, BofA 1, Goldman 1, Morgan Stanley 1.
